title: Chain route typed as `any` with unused errors (lint failure)
evidence_snippets: lines ~36-81 show `any` and unused err variables
reproduction: npm run lint reports no-explicit-any and unused-vars for chain route.
fix_idea: Type Supabase responses and remove unused err variables.

title: Meta route uses `any` for Supabase rows (lint failure)
reproduction: npm run lint errors on meta route any usages.

title: Previews route uses `any` and returns 200 on unexpected error
evidence_snippets: any at lines ~50,79,93; catch returns 200 with UNEXPECTED_ERROR
reproduction: npm run lint; force throw in handler -> UI gets 200 with empty previews.

title: Login page setState in effect (react-hooks warning)
fix_idea: Move error derivation to render or useEffect with guard/async pattern.

title: DetailCard stringifies objects, causing `[object Object]`
reproduction: If API adds structured field (e.g., payload), UI shows `[object Object]`.
fix_idea: Render primitives only or pretty-print JSON with guards.

title: Date parsing without null guard in detail cards
reproduction: If ts_utc missing/invalid, renders 'Invalid Date' and may throw in Date constructor.
fix_idea: Guard against falsy ts_utc before formatting.

title: Warning codes shown verbatim to user
evidence_snippets: warnings list renders raw codes like FLAG_FILTER_FALLBACK at ~310, ~322
reproduction: Trigger fallback -> UI shows code strings (English/technical).
fix_idea: Map codes to RU user-friendly messages.

title: API returns HTML/200 risk; build EPERM blocks CI
reproduction: npm run build fails due to .next permissions; deploy/build pipeline would fail.
fix_idea: Clean/chmod .next or configure output dir before build.

title: Chain endpoint returns 200 with empty data on errors
evidence_snippets: Catches errors, adds warning, still returns 200 with nulls
reproduction: Force Supabase error -> UI sees empty details with warning code only.
fix_idea: Return 500/explicit error or surface warning text in RU to user.
